prompt: Compare Q1-Q4 revenue, gross margin %, operating expenses, net income, and headcount across 5 regional offices (NA, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, MEA) for fiscal year 2025. Include YoY growth percentages for each metric.
stress: table with 25+ cells, small font risk, tight columns

prompt: Show a product roadmap timeline with 12 features across 4 workstreams (Platform, Mobile, AI, Infra) spanning Q1 2025 to Q4 2026. Each feature should have owner initials, status (done/in-progress/planned), and target date.
stress: timeline overflow, overlapping labels, horizontal cramming

prompt: Present our tech stack architecture: React frontend → API Gateway → 3 microservices (Auth, Orders, Payments) → PostgreSQL + Redis + S3. Show request flow, latency at each hop (ms), and error rates. Include a legend for status colors.
stress: architecture diagram density, arrow overlap, small annotation text

prompt: Competitive landscape matrix comparing our product against Notion, Confluence, Coda, and Monday across 8 dimensions: pricing, collaboration, API, mobile, AI features, integrations, security certifications, and customer support. Use checkmarks and ratings.
stress: comparison grid with 40+ cells, icon density, tight spacing

prompt: Customer journey map with 7 stages (Awareness, Consideration, Trial, Purchase, Onboarding, Adoption, Advocacy). For each stage show: touchpoints, emotions (happy/neutral/frustrated), key metrics, and team responsible.
stress: multi-row journey layout, stacked content per column

prompt: Sprint retrospective dashboard: 14 completed stories with story points, 3 bugs found in production, velocity chart for last 6 sprints, team happiness score trend, and top 5 action items with owners and due dates.
stress: mixed chart + list + table, everything competing for space

prompt: SWOT analysis for entering the Japanese market. 4 strengths, 5 weaknesses, 4 opportunities, 3 threats. Each point should be a full sentence explaining the reasoning, not just keywords.
stress: 4-quadrant layout with long text in each, font shrink risk

prompt: Sales pipeline breakdown: 47 deals across 5 stages (Prospecting $2.1M, Qualified $4.3M, Proposal $3.8M, Negotiation $2.7M, Closed Won $1.9M). Show deal count, average deal size, conversion rate between stages, and top 3 deals by name in each stage.
stress: funnel with embedded data, annotations per stage

prompt: Year-end financial summary: revenue $42.3M (+18% YoY), EBITDA $8.7M, burn rate $1.2M/month, runway 22 months, ARR $38.1M, NDR 118%, CAC $4,200, LTV $52,000, LTV:CAC 12.4x, gross margin 72%, Rule of 40 score: 46. Show all KPIs with sparkline trends.

prompt: Incident post-mortem timeline: 14 events over 6 hours from first alert (02:14 UTC) to full resolution (08:31 UTC). Include severity escalations, team handoffs, customer impact numbers at each stage, and 5 root causes identified.
stress: dense timeline with long annotations, vertical overflow

prompt: Org chart showing CEO, 6 C-suite reports, and their 22 direct reports with titles. Highlight 4 open headcount positions and 3 recent hires (< 90 days). Include department headcount totals.
stress: tree layout with 30+ nodes, connector line density

prompt: API rate limiting policy table: 8 endpoints (GET /users, POST /orders, PUT /settings, DELETE /account, GET /search, POST /upload, GET /analytics, POST /webhooks) with rate limits for 3 tiers (Free, Pro, Enterprise) showing requests/minute, burst capacity, and cooldown period.
stress: table with 24+ data cells plus headers, monospace risk

prompt: Marketing campaign results: compare 6 campaigns (Email, LinkedIn, Google Ads, Webinar, Content Syndication, Partner Co-sell) on impressions, clicks, CTR, leads generated, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline created, and cost per SQL. Highlight the winner in each metric.

prompt: Database migration plan with 9 steps: schema freeze, create read replica, dual-write enable, backfill historical data (2.3TB), validation checksums, traffic cutover (blue-green), rollback trigger conditions, monitoring dashboard links, and cleanup timeline. Show duration, risk level, and rollback plan for each step.
stress: process flow with 3 data points per step, dense annotations

prompt: SaaS pricing page comparison: 4 tiers (Starter $29/mo, Growth $79/mo, Business $199/mo, Enterprise custom) each listing 10 features with included/limited/not-included status. Show annual discount percentages and most popular badge.
stress: pricing grid with 40+ feature rows, checkmark/cross density

prompt: Risk register: 8 project risks with ID, description, probability (1-5), impact (1-5), risk score, mitigation strategy, owner, review date, and current status (open/mitigating/closed). Sort by risk score descending.
stress: wide table with 72+ cells, long description text in cells

prompt: Employee engagement survey results across 6 departments (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, HR) for 8 categories: career growth, compensation, work-life balance, management, team collaboration, company direction, DEI, and tools & resources. Show scores out of 5 with benchmark comparisons and delta arrows.
stress: heatmap-style grid with 48 scores, arrows, benchmark overlay

Show pass rates and p95 duration for each stage.

stress: multi-section dashboard, mixed content types on single slide
